top.line: Each of our companies, technologies and websites, mapped to what UAlgTec Heritage needs.
top.para: A sector is made of companies.

in-short.line: UTH wants a sector; we built small companies on one open layer; each maps to a heritage need.

why.line: A HeritageTech sector is made of small companies on shared infrastructure, the way ours is built.
why.para: The other half of the UTH map.

foundations.line: SGit, SG/Send, pki.sgit.ai and SHarness: vaults, lanes, keys and kernel boundaries for heritage.
foundations.para: Evidence per site, signed records, bounded agents.

abp.line: Agent Behaviour Policies and RiskMandate: a written, reviewed policy per platform agent.
abp.para: Evidence a funded project is asked for.

teams.line: AgentiCCells cells per group or startup; the site factory makes a site per dig and researcher.
teams.para: Kept up by the owner's own agent.

checking.line: GAMMA-Ray rates agents against standards; VoiceDebrief records field notes offline.

public.line: PrompTugal.news for heritage news by place, this newsroom for the record, native apps for visitors.
public.para: The public story with its proof.

together.line: One find: spoken, signed, stored, checked and published, each step by a different company.

model.line: Small, specialised companies on a shared, open trust layer: a shape for the sector.
model.para: Open parts free; companies sell setup and checks.

limits.line: A proposal; no heritage use yet; legal structure not described.

sources.line: Our own sites, UTH's form and earlier articles.
